evidence.golden_value: 30 (se cobrará una sola vez para cada cuota)
evidence.pdf_text_found: Penalidad por cada cuota impagado: 30 (se cobrará una sola vez para cada cuota)

atoms_span_match.text: Penalidad por cada cuota impagado: 30 (se cobrará una sola vez para cada cuota)

evidence.comment: The atoms span contains '30' where  is the Euro currency character (U+009F as used in this PDF encoding). The golden value captures '30 (se cobrará...)' dropping the euro sign between '30' and the parenthetical. The correct value is '30€ (se cobrará una sola vez para cada cuota)' or at minimum '30€ (se cobrará una sola vez para cada cuota)'. Omitting the currency unit from a monetary penalty amount is a substantive error.

params.new_value: 30€ (se cobrará una sola vez para cada cuota)
params.note: Replace \u009f with € — the PDF encodes the euro sign as byte 0x9F in this font. Normalize to UTF-8 euro sign.

The same misalignment applies to the three 'Fecha' pairs where all label_bbox.x=27.0 but atoms show 'Fecha 24-09-2019' at x=27.0, x=280.7, x=409.0.

params.note: Update label_bbox for En pairs 2+3 and Fecha pairs 2+3 to their respective column x positions. Atoms show three distinct 'En GIRONA' and 'Fecha 24-09-2019' fused spans at x=27.0/280.7/409.0.

findings.spec_location: kv_pairs / label=Importe diario derecho de desistimiento

evidence.comment: The atoms span reads '4,34 ' where  is the Euro currency character. The golden captures '4,34' stripping the currency unit. Visual PDF confirms '4,34 €'. For a daily cost amount the unit is load-bearing. Consistent with f01, the euro char should be preserved. Severity MEDIUM (not HIGH) because '4,34' IS a valid substring match and this is an amount field where currency can be inferred from context, but it is still an inaccurate capture.

params.note: Normalize \u009f to € — consistent with f01 treatment.

evidence.comment: Atoms span '507,00' — the  is the Euro currency character. Golden captures '507,00' without the unit. The substring '507,00' IS present in '507,00' so this is a match, but the unit is dropped. Similarly the second Financiadas value '0,00' is from '0,00'. Severity LOW because '507,00' is present as substring and context makes the currency clear, but ideally should be '507,00€'. Same note applies to the second Financiadas value='0,00' and No Condicionantes value='28,73' (atoms: '28,73').

proposed_fix.target: Financiadas (507,00) and Financiadas (0,00) and No Condicionantes (28,73)
